turn.say: NakhlaID says NID-423 when I try to sign in. What should I do?

turns.reply:
`NID-423` means your NakhlaID account is locked after 5 failed sign-ins within 15 minutes. [KB-006] You can either wait 30 minutes for it to unlock automatically, or unlock it at `https://id.nakhla.example/unlock` using your work email and a NakhlaKey prompt or backup code. [KB-004] [KB-006] If you also forgot your password, reset it instead; that also unlocks the account. [KB-006]

Other details could not be confirmed from the knowledge base, so they were left out. I can help you escalate this issue to the Service Desk.

turn.say: My NakhlaConnect VPN shows NX-112 since this morning. I work from home.

turns.reply:
First check the Nakhla status page at https://status.nakhla.example. [KB-002]

If the laptop was offline for more than 30 days, it needs to sync before the VPN will work again. [KB-002]

For NX-112: Open NakhlaManage > Sync; then restart the laptop; then check that the device is compliant. [KB-002]

turn.say: NakhlaConnect keeps failing with NX-503 since this morning and I can't reach anything. Please open a ticket.

turns.reply:
A matching active incident (INC-2207) is already being handled.

Workaround: In NakhlaConnect open Settings > Gateway and select GW-1 (Jerusalem), then reconnect. Finance users stay on GW-3 and are not affected.

Do not open individual tickets for this problem. Add yourself to INC-2207 on the status page (Affected? > Subscribe) to get updates.
